an7.75:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.75:1.7: sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an7.75:1.8: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an7.75:1.9: āsavānaṃ khaya anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.75:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotī
